policy: Original Vexed Mirror fiction only. These are deliberate game additions, not measured exoplanets or Star Trek canon. Systems absent from this list receive no invented neighboring worlds.

3.name: Lik Secundus
3.description: Original Vexed Mirror rocky survey world named in relation to Lik Prime. Its name and existence are game fiction; no Star Trek source establishes this neighbor.

6.name: Helvetia
6.description: Original Vexed Mirror highland moon. Its human colonial name follows New Switzerland's cultural theme; this is not a claimed canonical Trek moon.

7.name: Trey Borealis
7.description: Original Vexed Mirror frozen outer survey world. The name fits the existing Trey region; neither the planet nor its location is established in screen canon.

17.name: Skadi
17.description: Original Vexed Mirror gas giant with a Scandinavian mythological survey name fitting the Denmark region. Its name and system membership are game additions.

17.name: Rime
17.description: Original Vexed Mirror icy moon orbiting Skadi. Its name, existence and orbit are game fiction rather than an established Trek location.

21.name: Kovath
21.description: Original Vexed Mirror iron-rich rocky neighbor in Klingon-controlled Koann. Its cultural naming is invented for this game, not an asserted Klingon translation or screen planet.

23.name: Delphara
23.description: Original Vexed Mirror tidal moon of the aquatic Delpi world. The name follows the game's Delpin naming theme; it has no established connection to Delphi Ardu.

28.name: Tepos Major
28.description: Original Vexed Mirror outer gas giant with a regional survey name. Its name and membership in Tepos are game fiction.

41.name: Anorez Borealis
41.description: Original Vexed Mirror icy outer survey world. Its name, existence and local placement are game fiction.

41.name: Vesh
41.description: Original Vexed Mirror rocky moon of Anorez, with an invented local name. No screen or licensed source establishes this moon.

45.name: Khorat
45.description: Original Vexed Mirror cinder moon of Hos'Ichu. Its invented Klingon-inspired local name is not an asserted translation or canonical moon.

49.name: Erasariel Farpoint
49.description: Original Vexed Mirror distant ice giant. Farpoint is a local survey epithet here, not a claim that Deneb IV or Farpoint Station is in this system.
